description: Retrieve and compare official Spanish statistics (estadísticas del INE) using a verified series code. Show two comparable observations, dates, units and arithmetic changes.

defaultPrompt: Compare the available observations in INE series IPC251852 and show units and dates.
Consulta la serie IPC251852 del INE y calcula el cambio entre dos observaciones comparables.
Comprueba los periodos y la unidad de IPC251852 antes de interpretar su variación.
interface.longDescription: Compare official Spanish statistics from an INE series. Supply a verified series code to retrieve observations and compare two available comparable numeric periods. Keep the series name, observed periods and units alongside the values, absolute change and percentage change when defined. Use official source links to check the underlying series. The connector needs a series code; it does not discover a series from a topic alone, forecast future values or establish that an accessible series is still current. A change between observations is not automatically an annual growth rate.

name: ine-evidence
